description: Search the Unique AI Platform knowledge base using the unique-cli search command, with automatic per-turn citation tracking so cited facts render as clickable reference chips and `<sup>N</sup>` footnotes on the Unique platform. Use whenever the user asks to find, search, or query documents or content on Unique, including filtering by folder or metadata. Also covers `unique-cli read <cont_id>` for reading the full indexed text of a document when its content ID is already known. NOTE: This search uses combined vector + full-text indexing. Excel (.xlsx/.xls), CSV (.csv), and image files are NOT full-text indexed, so they will not appear in search results. To locate these file types, use the unique-cli-file-management skill instead (browse folders with `unique-cli ls` to find them by name).
